name: krakenkey-cli
description: Tools for using the KrakenKey CLI (v0.4.0) for TLS certificate management and endpoint monitoring. Global flags must come before the command (krakenkey --output json cert list); flags placed after the command are not treated as global flags.

--api-key.description: API key (kk_...). Overrides the env var and config file

--output.description: Output format. json prints indented JSON on stdout and errors as {"error":"..."} on stderr

--no-color.description: Disable colored output. Setting the NO_COLOR env var has the same effect

--verbose.description: Accepted but currently has no effect

tools.name: auth_login
tools.description: Validate an API key against the API and save it to the config file (~/.config/krakenkey/config.yaml, mode 0600). Prompts on stdin if --api-key is not given

--api-key.description: API key to save (prompted interactively if not provided)

tools.name: auth_logout
tools.description: Remove the stored API key from the config file. Does not unset KK_API_KEY

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Show the current user, email, plan, and resource counts (domains, certificates, API keys). Exits 5 if no API key is configured

tools.name: auth_keys_list
tools.description: List API keys in a table (ID, Name, Created, Expires)

tools.name: auth_keys_create
tools.description: Create a new API key. The key value is shown only once

tools.name: auth_keys_delete
tools.description: Delete an API key by ID

tools.name: domain_add
tools.description: Register a domain and print the TXT verification record (name: the domain itself, value: krakenkey-site-verification=...). The CLI does not print the _acme-challenge CNAME that issuance also requires

tools.name: domain_list
tools.description: List registered domains in a table (ID, Hostname, Verified, Created)

tools.name: domain_show
tools.description: Show domain details including verification code and TXT record name

tools.name: domain_verify
tools.description: Ask the API to check the TXT verification record and mark the domain verified. Checks the TXT record only, not the _acme-challenge CNAME. Exits 1 if the record is not found

tools.name: domain_delete
tools.description: Delete a registered domain

tools.name: endpoint_add
tools.description: Add a monitored endpoint for TLS scanning, optionally assigning connected probes. Subject to plan limits

--probe.description: Connected probe ID to assign (repeat for multiple)

tools.name: endpoint_list
tools.description: List monitored endpoints in a table (ID, Host, Port, Label, Active, Probes, Regions, Created)

tools.name: endpoint_show
tools.description: Show endpoint details including SNI, label, hosted regions, and assigned probes. Does not show scan results

tools.name: endpoint_scan
tools.description: Request an on-demand TLS scan of an endpoint. The CLI does not display scan results; read them in the dashboard or via the API (GET /endpoints/:id/results)

tools.name: endpoint_probes
tools.description: List your connected probes available for assignment (ID, Name, Region, Status, Last Seen)

tools.name: endpoint_enable
tools.description: Enable a disabled endpoint to resume monitoring

tools.name: endpoint_disable
tools.description: Disable an endpoint to pause monitoring without deleting it

tools.name: endpoint_delete
tools.description: Delete an endpoint

tools.name: endpoint_probe_add
tools.description: Assign a connected probe to an endpoint. Get probe IDs from endpoint probes

tools.name: endpoint_probe_remove
tools.description: Remove a connected probe from an endpoint

tools.name: endpoint_region_add
tools.description: Add a hosted probe region to an endpoint (Starter tier+) so KrakenKey-operated probes scan it from that region

tools.name: endpoint_region_remove
tools.description: Remove a hosted probe region from an endpoint

tools.name: cert_issue
tools.description: Generate a private key and CSR locally, submit the CSR, and optionally wait for issuance. The private key never leaves the machine. The CN is always included as a SAN. Key (0600) and CSR are written immediately; cert, chain, and fullchain files are written only with --wait. Every name in the CSR needs a verified domain and an _acme-challenge CNAME, or issuance fails

--san.description: Additional SAN (repeat for multiple; IP addresses become IP SANs)

--fullchain-out.description: Leaf + intermediates output path (written with --wait). Most web servers want this file

--auto-renew.description: Explicitly enable auto-renewal after submitting. The API already enables auto-renewal on new certificates; use cert update --auto-renew=false to turn it off

--wait.description: Poll until the certificate is issued, failed, or revoked, then write the output files

--poll-interval.description: How often to poll for status (Go duration)

tools.name: cert_submit
tools.description: Submit an existing CSR PEM file for issuance and optionally wait. Output file names default to the CSR's CN (or the cert ID if there is no CN)

--wait.description: Poll until the certificate is issued, failed, or revoked, then write the output files

--poll-interval.description: How often to poll for status (Go duration)

tools.name: cert_list
tools.description: List certificates in a table (ID, Domain, Status, Expires, Auto-renew)

tools.name: cert_show
tools.description: Show certificate details. For issued certs, text output adds serial, issuer, validity, fingerprint, and each intermediate in the chain. JSON output is the certificate record (includes crtPem and chainPem)

tools.name: cert_download
tools.description: Write the PEM of an issued certificate to a file. Fails if the certificate is not issued. JSON output is {"path": ..., "format": ...}

--format.description: cert = leaf only, chain = intermediates only, fullchain = leaf + intermediates

--out.description: Output file path. Default suffix follows --format: .crt, .chain.crt, or .fullchain.crt

tools.name: cert_renew
tools.description: Trigger renewal of a certificate. Renewal reuses the stored CSR, so the existing private key stays valid. Does not write files; run cert download afterward

--poll-interval.description: How often to poll for status (Go duration)

tools.name: cert_revoke
tools.description: Revoke an issued certificate

--reason.description: RFC 5280 reason code (0-10). Omitted from the request if not set

tools.name: cert_retry
tools.description: Retry a failed issuance with the same CSR, for example after fixing a missing _acme-challenge CNAME. Does not write files; run cert download afterward

--poll-interval.description: How often to poll for status (Go duration)

tools.name: cert_update
tools.description: Update certificate settings. Currently only auto-renewal

--auto-renew.description: Enable or disable auto-renewal. Pass the value with = (--auto-renew=true or --auto-renew=false)

tools.name: cert_delete
tools.description: Delete a failed or revoked certificate record

tools.name: account_show
tools.description: Show profile details: ID, username, email, display name, plan, resource counts, and member-since date

tools.name: account_plan
tools.description: Show subscription plan, status, current period end, and cancellation state

tools.name: version
tools.description: Print the CLI version (krakenkey-cli <version>; dev for source builds without version injection)
